description: The figure displays two pie charts representing an error analysis comparing a Vanilla model on the left and an HCL model on the right. A shared legend positioned above the charts identifies four categories, each corresponding to a distinct color. Both pie charts consist of four slices with percentage labels displayed directly inside each segment, and neither chart features visually emphasized, exploded, or offset slices. In the left pie chart for the Vanilla model, the largest slice is "Atomic Skill Fail" in dark teal at 68.0%, followed by "Correct" in medium teal at 12.0%, "Reason Error" in light blue at 12.0%, and "Question Misunderstood" in very light grey at 8.0%. In the right pie chart for the HCL model, the largest segment is again "Atomic Skill Fail" in dark teal at 55.0%, followed by "Correct" in medium teal at 21.0%, "Reason Error" in light blue at 14.0%, and "Question Misunderstood" in very light grey at 10.0%. The slices in both charts do not appear to follow a strict ascending or descending order by size.
